reviews.neutralCapabilitySummary: Designs permission-governed transactional and marketing email delivery around separated reputation domains, queued retries, event-state tracking, versioned templates, bounce suppression, recipient preferences, multipart accessibility, authentication records, and per-recipient recovery evidence.
